measurement_search.reason: The official ATH measurement page explicitly describes uncalibrated levels, non-constant drive, approximate angles, indoor 4.5-5 ms gating, and supplies plots rather than reusable numeric raw data. The official AKABAK studies point to downloadable example projects and illustrated comparisons, but the inspected public pages do not expose a compact raw measurement set with all geometry, excitation, calibration, angle, distance, gating/smoothing and reuse terms needed for the frozen pointwise numerical comparison. No plot digitization was substituted for raw data.

limits: The comparison verifies ATH geometry generation and WUT CFG rendering, not AKABAK pressure accuracy.
No physical measurement benchmark is claimed.
The WUT-added LE/AKABAK assignments do not alter this geometry-only output; their acoustic semantics are covered by separate contracts, not this reference.
